justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/MemberRemoval.java` lines 154-213. The nested `MemberRemovingClassVisitor` is a small private visitor with only one constructor plus two override methods (`visitField`, `visitMethod`), and both methods do the same narrow job: look up a member in a map and either suppress or delegate the ASM call. The class has a single responsibility and no evidence of excess methods, mixed concerns, or separable sub-abstractions, so insufficient modularization is not present.
